role: Independent local source-only review of the isolated individual-prefix representation and real-B8 diagnostic interfaces.

representation_review.finding: No concrete source-level shape, ownership or interface defect found in the reviewed version; not numerical acceptance.

checks.observation: Opt-in rows use each original request start aligned to 64 and literal context_tokens. Existing consumer order, B4 and public capture-count synchronization remain. The default scalar route remains the baseline route.

Per-row factual ID checks address the original artifact row. Each consumption constructs a fresh public DynamicCache; FA prefix rows are right-padded to the carrier width and GDN uses its actual stored boundary. Original public cache update order is retained.
Only target predictor positions and suffix extent are rebased. Original sample/label identities and interleaved endpoint order remain; true Li bounds come from saved request context, not common Lmax.

Native suffix uses per-row pi and Li, explicit absolute position_ids, full FA mask with interior carrier holes and separate GDN suffix mask. Finite K/V remove carrier holes to logical maxLi; signed output is restored to original pi:Li positions.

Uses the original installed packing/padding and public varlen FA interface. Measured public LSE representation is H,totalQ FP32; transpose-pad-transpose restores B,H,Smax. The review does not promote that interface observation to numerical acceptance.
Only an original unchanged sentinel equal to original Lmax is replaced by true Li. Shared scalar prefix is reported None in row mode; physical carrier width is recorded separately.
Row behavior is conditional on prefix_lengths metadata. Original scalar finite arithmetic/callbacks remain selected when metadata is absent; this is a source review, not a new output-equality test.

diagnostic_review.finding: No concrete runtime dispatch/capture-composition defect found in the reviewed diagnostic sources.

checks.observation: Labels select baseline cold/warm, then row cold/warm, then a separate row-observed call. Row class and finite_fa are switched together. The candidate runner RightPaddedLengths global is bound to the same candidate finite-wrapper class, preserving its isinstance contract.

Baseline and row each prepare one full88-request bank. Entering row cold clears the previous diagnostic bank; row warm and observed reuse the row bank. They are not the same immutable bank across scalar/row variants.

One capture_backend namespace combines the original decoder class, GDN0 observer subclass and FA3-varlen observer subclass. No public attribute observer argument is passed, so the existing prefix path is not disabled.

Original selected_attribute receives original args/kwargs. Inner finally restores saved capture_backend and row finite operator. Export and reference checking are separate; only the fifth observed label bears added snapshot/copy/export overhead.
Outer variant finally restores original attribute, class, finite operator, capture backend and original optional flags even if the observed operation raises.

Calls original capture event first. The existing replay0 call supplies actual public/stage operands; original capture-count expectation is one record. This observer does not add a native model or FLA call.

Adds only its retention names to the supplied original FA capture. Original exit clears hooks but keeps captured values readable, enabling the subsequent CPU copy. Original varlen profile exposes packed Q/K/V, cu_seqlens, mask and output.

Calls the original finite operator first and returns the exact same result object. Original attention finite owner calls it once per FA decoder; reverse order makes call8 decoder3. Operands and returned dq/dk/dv/tau/center are tensors compatible with the snapshot interface.

limitations: Source inspection is not FA/FLA tolerance acceptance, whole-DT numerical acceptance, 32k capacity acceptance, performance validation or formal deployment.

The scalar and row banks are separately captured with their required boundaries; changed capture geometry may affect native values. Cross-bank QVA differences cannot be attributed solely to the finite ABI.
Raw equality/max-absolute-difference observations are descriptive and introduce no full-network tolerance.
No official reference assertion was executed in this source review. Offline official checks must retain their original ownership and scope.
The separate fifth observed phase includes CPU copies and exports and must not be presented as the first four unobserved timing results.
Original verify_native_prefix_artifacts.py remains SHA22bc698c7ae848581c1572095029c17e3542209589a8faa8d12109b3337ec7e8; original actor loading, precision and release interfaces are reused.
